name: SurgiPulse
full_name: SurgiPulse robot-assisted mitral valve interventional repair system (robotic M-TEER)
group: SurgiPulse (Surgi-Pulse) Robotics Co., Ltd.; clinical: Xiamen Cardiovascular Hospital of Xiamen University (Yan Wang) and Fuwai Yunnan Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences (Xiangbin Pan) (zhu2025_firstinman)
versions: 2024 first-in-human robotic M-TEER (chen2024_firstinhuman; also Zhu D et al., JACC Cardiovasc Interv 2024;17:1505-1506, 'pure echo guidance', cited as zhu2025 ref. 1, not read) -> 2025 multicentre first-in-man series, 9 patients including 2 telerobotic over 5G (zhu2025_firstinman)
target_anatomy: structural heart: mitral valve (transcatheter edge-to-edge repair)
devices_driven: 3 devices at once: three single-use sterile functional modules drive the steerable guiding catheter, the clip delivery catheter and the clip control sheath; compatible with MitraClip G4 (Abbott) and similar TEER systems; MitraClip G4 in 5 and Kyrin (Shenqi Medical) in 4 patients (zhu2025_firstinman); SQ-Kyrin-M in the 2024 case (chen2024_firstinhuman)
translation_detail: other: motorised sterile adapters on the TEER handles (mechanism N.R.)
haptics_leader: control cockpit with 3 joysticks and buttons, one per control component (zhu2025_firstinman); doctor console with buttons and a rocker, on-site or remote (chen2024_firstinhuman); force feedback N.R.
imaging_compat: TEE (echo-guided) + fluoroscopy, operator outside the cath lab (chen2024_firstinhuman); 2 telerobotic procedures over 5G (zhu2025_firstinman)
sterility: 3 single-use sterile functional modules (zhu2025_firstinman); sterile adapters between motors and instruments (chen2024_firstinhuman)
validation_detail: 1 patient, 2 clips, MR severe -> mild, 29 min (chen2024_firstinhuman, PMC HTML); 9 patients, multicentre single-arm, 2 operators, 2 telerobotic via 5G; transseptal sheath placement and clip release done by hand (zhu2025_firstinman)
key_numbers: 2024: procedure 29 min; baseline EROA 0.93 cm2, vena contracta 15.1 mm (chen2024_firstinhuman). 2025: 9/9 successful, 12 clips (7 MitraClip G4 XTW, 5 Kyrin), robotic time median 38 min (range 22-127), 36.5 min per clip; at 30 days MR <=2+ in all and 0-1+ in 7/9, NYHA I-II 8/9, no deaths, rehospitalisations or complications (zhu2025_firstinman)

notes: Company product; structural-heart scope; may belong in A4's commercial list. A telerobotic 8-case M-TEER series attributed to SurgiPulse appears in a 2025 EuroIntervention review (WebSearch snippet, not verified). | X2 2026-11-08: zhu2025 read in full: 9 patients, 3 devices driven at once. Clinical site corrected to Fuwai Yunnan Hospital (Kunming). The 2024 echo-guided first-in-man letter (Zhu 2024) and chen2024 both claim a first case; whether they describe the same patient is not stated.
